tatulogue-hoodie.description: Shop-day hoodie with the blackletter T on the chest. Heavy blend fleece, unisex fit, S–2XL. Printed when you order it — built for convention floors, flights between guest spots, and everything after the session.
tatulogue-hoodie.seo_title: Tatulogue Hoodie — Blackletter T Tattoo Streetwear

tatulogue-snapback.description: The blackletter T, stitched not printed. Embroidered snapback, one size fits most. The quiet nod that you're in the culture.
